title: Lightmap bake crash if texel density is high
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build.6c9765d87

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04 Nvidia 2060

### Issue description

Lightmap crash when setting the texel density to 3 in the MRP

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce
Use the Backyard Bistro Scene
Add a Lightmap node
Set it to 3 texel density
Set quality to low

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Backyard Bistro Scene MRP](https://www.dropbox.com/s/m5afh2bh3gsb1aj/LumberyardBistro_Godot4.zip?dl=0)
